After reviewing the information provided by the user, the IT Helpdesk guided the user to reboot the VNPT router using the following methods:
Method 1: Reboot using the Power button
Locate the Power button on the router.
Press the button to power off the device.
Wait for 10–15 seconds.
Press the Power button again to turn it back on.
Method 2: Reboot by disconnecting the power adapter
Unplug the router’s power adapter.
Wait for 10–20 seconds to allow the internal capacitors to discharge.
Plug the power adapter back in.

Since both rebooting methods and cable checks did not resolve the problem, the IT Helpdesk instructed the user to contact VNPT’s technical support hotline (1800 1166) for further troubleshooting.
